question_stem:
A laser is placed in front of a double slit, as shown in Fig. 7.1.
The laser emits light of frequency 670 THz. Interference fringes are observed on the screen.
question_stem_latex:
A laser is placed in front of a double slit, as shown in Fig. 7.1.
The laser emits light of frequency 670 THz. Interference fringes are observed on the screen.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question_text: Explain how the interference fringes are formed.
parts.question_text_latex: Explain how the interference fringes are formed.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text: Show that the wavelength of the light is 450 nm.
parts.question_text_latex: Show that the wavelength of the light is 450 nm.

parts.label: (c)
parts.question_text:
The separation of the maxima P and Q observed on the screen is 12 mm. The distance
between the double slit and the screen is 2.8 m.
Calculate the separation of the two slits.
separation = m

parts.label: (d)
parts.question_text:
The laser is replaced by a laser emitting red light. State and explain the effect on the
interference fringes seen on the screen.
